data_fields.name: sequence_mode
data_fields.donor_constant: flags: 1 stopping, 2 cycle, 4 shuffle, 8 once; six accepted combinations

data_fields.name: branch_count
data_fields.donor_constant: number of sequence elements n (stopping clamps at n-1; once adds one empty branch)

data_fields.name: shuffle_pool_size
data_fields.donor_constant: n, or n-1 when shuffle with stopping

data_fields.name: once_only_choice
data_fields.donor_constant: true by default; hidden when target visits > 0

best_idea: Use a per-pass shuffle (a fresh permutation for each n visits, no repeats within a pass) seeded per character, so NPC barks never repeat within a pass and replay the same way.
decision_why: The per-pass shuffle and the turn clock fit NPC barks and quest-giver lines; we seed per character with a proper hash and mix instead of the donor's character-code sum and clock default, and keep the server as the only place that runs the sequence.
acceptance: Over three passes of a four-line bark each line is shown once per pass; the same character seed gives the same order and another seed a different one; a once-only choice disappears after its target is entered.
